The epidemiology of some mosquito-transmitted diseases is complex enough to warrant development of bespoke models.

# Dengue

There is some interest in the strain structure of dengue, and differences in the risk of severe disease that result from getting exposed to multiple strains in a different order.

No dengue models are currently included, but some have been planned.
